Good Morning Dosto!
Welcome back to another exciting infrastructure update from Andhra Pradesh.
In today’s video, we explore the Bhogapuram International Airport — the upcoming mega aviation hub in Vizianagaram District being developed by GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd (GVIAL) with civil work executed by L&T.
Chapters: -
Key Highlights:
Runway Length: 3,800 meters – Wide-body aircraft (Boeing 777, Airbus A350) ready
Passenger Capacity: 6 million/year in Phase-1, expandable to 18 million by Phase-3
Dedicated Cargo Terminal for export-import logistics
